note: Validated tactics library. Entries tune resolver parameters only; they never grant information or bypass the legal-action masker.

tactics.name: Widen standoff when outnumbered
tactics.rationale: Soldier rifle damage falls from 3.0 to 0.4 HP across 18 m, so extra range costs little while denying the enemy concentrated close-range fire.

tactics.name: Close the distance when ahead
tactics.rationale: Damage is highest inside 6 m; a numerical advantage converts best at short range.

tactics.name: Punish an exposed enemy Main
tactics.rationale: Defeating the opposing Main ends the match; an unescorted Main is the highest-value legal target.

tactics.name: Shield the wounded Main
tactics.rationale: A Main below 35% HP only recovers by dealing damage and below 10% receives no reinforcement waves.

tactics.name: Contest an uncollected supply pickup
tactics.rationale: A Main below full ammunition gains up to 20 rounds from the central pickup.

tactics.name: Refill at the reinforcement zone
tactics.rationale: Soldiers refill six reserve rounds inside their own zone once every 20 s.

tactics.name: Probe the open lane when blind
tactics.rationale: With no legitimate sighting SLAI acts on priors and never tracks through walls.
